title: SemText document schema
description: Machine-readable contract for SemText documents, derived from spec/conventions.md (v0.7) and the per-element prose contracts in spec/schema/*.md. The prose files are normative; this file is the enforcement layer that semtext-validate reads. Changes here precede spec changes precede code, same as the prose contracts.

root.description: Exactly one per document when the document uses the SemText vocabulary; plain HTML without vocabulary is not a SemText document (conventions.md §1).

tierMarkers.description: Runtime-written marker (conventions.md §4); authored occurrences suggest a stale export or a hand-edited render.

generatedChrome.description: Elements the script generates at runtime must not appear in authored source.

spelling.description: conventions.md §2: bare attributes are canonical on sem-* custom elements; standard HTML elements keep the data-* spelling; writing both spellings on one element is an authoring error.

defPresets.description: Reusable $def fragments. A $def's `extends` (one preset name or an array) merges the preset UNDER the def's own keys — local attributes win, children/childRules concatenate preset-first — so a contract's $def stays a few lines. Consumers: src/validate/validate.js loadSchema (resolution happens there; this block is documentation + the source of truth for the preset shapes).

container.description: A block container that groups authored children: `label` names the group (rendered as generated chrome), `open` keeps a collapsible container expanded. Children are element-specific — declare them locally.

reference.description: A pointer to an upstream record: the org/project/key/id quartet identifies it; nothing is fetched — the element renders whatever its contract says the pointer means.

cachedEmbed.description: A cached embed of upstream content: the authored inner content IS the record (extraction reads it, never the network). `endpoint` names the refresh source, `fixtures` (optional) marks a fixture-backed dev source, `last-refreshed` stamps the last sync, `status` is the authored freshness token consumers may rely on with JS off (conventions §4: no script reads status — its consumers are no-script CSS rules).

value.note: out-of-range clamps for rendering; raw attr stays (sem-progress.md)

childRules.description: the listing's <pre> — authored directly, or minted by the element when the listing is authored flat (no <pre>); more than one is an error

kind.note: kind/tags are not global on sem-source (sem-source.md)

name.note: data-name alias spelling; renders as the table caption

on.note: the named key column, present in both buckets

sem-data-query.note: text body is the default §8 query; the chrome is rendered by the reading bundle

sem-step.description: The sem-step contract, as authored inside a workflow: the workflow-context parameters (action/description/gate/check/if-no/output) are per-parent, so sem-procedure steps are untouched. The shared status catalog still applies.

node.description: A tree entry as authored inside a site tree: path is required in tree context (a bare node elsewhere is an unknown-attribute warning).
A tree entry as authored inside a file tree: path is required in tree context; mode=text carries no node children at all (the authored pre is the record).
A node nested inside another node — the same tree-node form, one level deeper.

semext-annotate.description: Visitor comment threads, service-backed: the ONE semext element with a client live read (anonymous-read, text-only rendering of untrusted comment bodies). Snapshot mode renders the authored thread record; live mode fetches <endpoint>/threads?site&page once, no credentials, and falls back to the authored view on failure.

semext-docptr.description: A doc-pointer card from a cached snapshot (static; refresh is the CLI lane). The snapshot mirrors .meta/pointers.yaml entries; marker/uuid/token select the entry, file narrows by path.

semext-media-prompt.description: An authored .media.prompt YAML record with an output cache region the refresh CLI fills; the component never fetches or generates — it reports the region state (filled asset list or not-generated placeholder chrome).

semext-sig-logs.description: A SigNoz log-line snapshot + deep-link chrome (cached + link; livePolicy never, no client credentials). Link built from query/range/env via the plain sig-link builder.

semext-sig-metrics.description: A SigNoz metrics-table snapshot + deep-link chrome (cached + link; livePolicy never, no client credentials). Link built from query/range/env via the plain sig-link builder.

semext-sig-synthetic-monitor.description: A SigNoz synthetic-monitor DEFINITION card + link chrome (definition + link; live execution is an EE service surface, deliberately deferred). Link built from monitor/env via the plain sig-link builder.

semext-sig-traces.description: A SigNoz trace-list snapshot + deep-link chrome (cached + link; livePolicy never, no client credentials). Link built from query/range/env via the plain sig-link builder.

semext-styleguide-theme.description: A theme token card from a cached snapshot (static): name, key color swatches, typography sample, and a "Preview theme CSS" link whose href is the authored src.

semext-styleguide-themes.description: Collection wrapper of the styleguide-theme pair: authored semext-styleguide-theme entries; the wrapper renders only a summary line from its snapshot (theme slugs) or its authored children.
